baserow._baseUrlComment: Deliberately empty: this repo is public, so the catalogue host is supplied at run time via the BASEROW_URL environment variable (a repository variable in CI). Setting it here would publish your internal hostname.
baserow._tablesComment: Open a table and read the ids straight off the URL: /database/<databaseId>/table/<tableId>/<viewId>. Only the table id matters here. A 0 means not created yet - the tools fall back to seed/ until all four are set.

_channelsComment: Only versions on these channels reach the published index. 'dev' is deliberately excluded.
